details.heading: About Dr. Saleh Al-Khalaf

bio.p1: Dr. Saleh Al-Ghamdi is a professor and senior consultant in plastic and reconstructive surgery and cosmetic surgery, with extensive experience in both precise cosmetics and complex reconstructive care. His practice is based on the firm conviction that plastic surgery is not about fashion or excessive change, but about precision, balance, and long-term function. Each patient is treated as an individual through careful assessment, honest discussion, and thoughtful planning. Patients choose Dr. Al-Ghamdi for his clear communication and commitment to natural, stable, and appropriate results — without exaggeration.
bio.p2: Dr. Al-Ghamdi completed the plastic surgery residency program at the Military Hospitals in Riyadh, then obtained the board and advanced professional certifications from the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties, being recognized at the level of consultant in plastic and reconstructive surgery. He also expanded his experience through international fellowships in Germany at the Munich Bogenhausen University Hospital of the Technical University of Munich, where he completed advanced programs in craniofacial surgery, reconstructive microsurgery, hand surgery, and burn reconstruction. This advanced European experience has shaped his precise surgical style and deep understanding of anatomy, tissue behavior, and long-term functional results.

patientJourney.intro: We believe that the patient experience is not limited to the medical procedure only, but begins from the first contact and continues until the desired results are achieved. Therefore, the patient journey with Dr. Saleh is designed to be clear, organized, and human, with a focus on safety, understanding, and full respect for each patient's needs.

step1.title: Booking the Consultation
step1.description: The journey begins by contacting the clinic to book an initial consultation appointment. During this stage:
details: Patient needs and expectations are carefully listened to
Answering all questions and inquiries
Initial explanation of possible procedures and what to expect
Providing a comfortable environment that encourages honest dialogue without pressure

step2.title: Comprehensive Medical Evaluation
step2.description: At the consultation appointment, Dr. Saleh performs a precise medical evaluation including:
details: Reviewing medical history and general health
Precise anatomical evaluation related to the requested procedure
Understanding the patient's treatment goals
Discussing realistic expectations and possible outcomes
Clarifying appropriate medical options based on science and experience
step2.note: Transparency here is a key element, because the right medical decision starts from a complete understanding of the case.

step3.title: Creating a Personalized Treatment Plan
step3.description: After evaluation, a customized and integrated treatment plan is built:
details: Specially designed according to the patient's health condition
Compliant with safe medical standards
Explaining the type of procedure, its stages, and duration
Clearly explaining potential benefits and risks
Answering any questions before making the decision

step4.title: Medical Procedure
details: According to the highest safety and quality standards
Using modern and certified techniques
In a fully equipped medical environment
With close attention to all details to ensure the best possible outcome
step4.note: Patient comfort and safety is the top priority at this stage.

step5.title: Follow-up After Treatment
step5.description: The journey does not end with the procedure, rather the follow-up phase begins:
details: Regular follow-up visits according to the case
Monitoring recovery and ensuring the safety of results
Providing clear post-procedure care instructions
Quick handling of any observations or inquiries

step6.title: Continuous Support
step6.description: We believe that true medical care is ongoing:
details: Possibility of contacting the medical team when needed
Medical and psychological support that ensure the patient's comfort
Long-term follow-up to achieve the best possible results
step6.note: Because our concern for you does not stop at the end of treatment.
